title: DJ
description: An incredible codebreaker and amoral thief who dwelled in the shadows of Canto Bight, DJ wasn't the sort of operator who took sides. He followed the money. When Rose Tico and Finn offered him money to break onto Snoke's ship, he followed them there. When they were caught, he gave them up and followed the money to freedom. He was a big believer in the advice he gave to Finn, "Don't join."
